'''Quint-berry fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Romin]], gleaned from the shrub of the same name. Called also by the name "quinberry," the fruit was used to make the ultra-saccharine beverage [[quint-berry juice]], but also the sweet pastry, [[quinberry cake]].
